narration: 55% of workers give their vacation days back to their boss every year. That's $4,200 of your own earned pay — handed over completely for free. And almost nobody realizes they're doing it.
visual: SVG person silhouette on the left handing a stack of bills labeled 'PTO' to a larger boss silhouette on the right. Arrow animation between them. Red badge drops in: '$4,200 / YEAR — HANDED BACK FREE'.

narration: Across America, 768 million vacation days went unused last year alone. That's billions in earned pay workers just quietly gave away. So why does it keep happening?
visual: Large counter animating up to '768M' on a light background. Three calendar icons below with red X marks crossing out vacation days. Sub-text fades in: 'A CULTURE THAT MADE YOU THINK REST = WEAKNESS'.

narration: Research says the number-one reason workers skip vacation isn't workload — it's fear. You're scared you'll look replaceable if you step away. So you silently pay your boss $4,200 a year to feel safe.
visual: SVG person frozen at a laptop desk, worried expression. Thought bubble floats up: 'LOOK REPLACEABLE?' Boss silhouette with crossed arms visible in the background. Stat fades in at bottom.

narration: Here's the twist — workers who take all their vacation are 40% more productive than those who don't. Skipping PTO doesn't make you more valuable. It makes you burnt out and slower.
visual: Two animated bar charts on a light background: red 'NO PTO' bar shorter, green 'FULL PTO' bar 40% taller. A '+40%' annotation arrow appears. Sub-text: 'SKIPPING PTO MAKES YOU WORSE, NOT BETTER'.

narration: And the health cost is brutal. Men who regularly skip vacations face a 30% higher risk of heart disease. Your unused PTO isn't just money — it literally has a medical price tag.
visual: SVG heart with heartbeat ECG line inside, pulsing animation. Horizontal risk meter fills to 70% as a year counter ticks from 0 to 30. Red badge drops in: '30% HIGHER HEART DISEASE RISK FOR MEN'.

narration: The move is simple: schedule one week off before September ends. You already earned that money. Stop letting your employer keep it — and follow for more money facts nobody tells you.
visual: SVG calendar with a highlighted week in September. Beach bag with sun icon beside it. Two numbered steps slide in: '1. Block one week before Sept 30' and '2. You earned it — stop giving it back'. Green CTA button pulses at bottom.
